Title: EVT-OP-035: Monotonicity of the discrete Pickands constants
Labels: open-problem, area:processes, type:research, difficulty:hard, status:research

**Status in the survey:** OPEN-EXPLICIT for `α ∉ {1, 2}`; the related Dieker–Yakir and `1/Γ(1/α)` conjectures are resolved. Low priority in the survey.

## Source and quote
Bisewski and Jasnovidov, J. Appl. Probab. 2024, arXiv:2108.00756:

> It is therefore natural to speculate that $\delta\mapsto\mathcal{H}_{\alpha}^{\delta}$ is a decreasing function.

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
Practitioners simulate Pickands constants on grids, so the sign and size of the grid bias matter.

## What the library already has
Nothing on Gaussian processes beyond Mathlib's Gaussian measures and Brownian motion.

## What is missing
Everything. The `α = 2` items are known results, estimated as easy.
